verdict.rationale: Convertio's own site states both parts of the story: uploaded files are deleted instantly and converted files are deleted after 24 hours. The statement is a single marketing-page line, not a detailed retention policy. Missing for 10: a dedicated retention or privacy policy page, retention details for API and paid-account conversions, an on-demand deletion option, and independent or hands-on corroboration that deletion happens as claimed.

support.subject: As an ops lead, a hosted converter documents how long uploads are kept and when converted files are deleted

citations.quote: We delete uploaded files instantly and converted ones after 24 hours.
